name: Musaed
project_description:
Musaed is an advanced accessibility tool that helps make your website inclusive for all users. It offers customizable features to support visitors with disabilities, including vision, cognitive, or motor challenges, while ensuring compliance with accessibility standards. Musaed enhances usability, engages a wider audience, and maintains your brand’s unique look and feel through seamless integration.

 To use Musaed, a subscription on musaed.co is required, enabling you to access a unique client ID for integration.
